slides.text: Nvidia's big robot AI news has nothing to do with your phones.
slides.voiceover_text: Did you know Nvidia's big robot AI news has absolutely nothing to do with answering your phones? Here's why.

slides.text: Ignore vendors pitching cutting-edge physical AI for your intake calls.
slides.voiceover_text: Tip one: ignore any vendor pitching cutting-edge physical AI for your intake calls. Your phones don't need robotics.

slides.text: Buy boring, reliable conversational AI that handles your call volume.
slides.voiceover_text: Tip two: buy boring, reliable conversational AI that handles your call volume without dropping leads.

slides.text: Ask about fallback systems and a track record of uptime.
slides.voiceover_text: Tip three: ask about fallback systems and a proper track record of uptime before you sign anything.

slides.text: For your phones, boring reliability beats every buzzword a vendor throws.
slides.voiceover_text: So remember: for your phones, boring reliability beats every clever buzzword a vendor can throw at you.
